name: folder
label: Folder
help: For example `invoices/2026`. Missing folders are created. Leave it empty for the root of the bucket.

name: data
label: Data
help: The content of the file, for example from an HTTP or a cloud storage module.

name: conflict
label: If the name is taken
help: What to do when a file with this name exists in the folder: "Fail" stops with an error, "Rename" uploads it as "name (1)", and "Replace" overwrites it at the storage provider. Nubbo keeps no copy of the old file; a bucket with versioning keeps it as an older version.

name: contentType
label: MIME type
help: The MIME type, for example `application/pdf`. Leave it empty and the storage provider stores a generic type.
